evals.prompt: 帮我生成一张图：一只可爱的柴犬坐在樱花树下
evals.expected_output: If this is the first generation request in the session, runs `--preflight --no-gen` first. Then runs the genius.py script by absolute path with workdir set to the current session workspace, and reports the generated file path under `<workspace>/genius_output/`, task_id, media_urls, duration, and credits used.

evals.prompt: 生成前先检查一下环境，不要真的生图
evals.expected_output: Runs genius.py by absolute path with `--preflight --no-gen` from the current session workspace and reports key/workdir/tunnel pass/fail without creating a generation task.

evals.prompt: 用4个模型跑一下同一张图对比效果，prompt是"赛博朋克夜景"
evals.expected_output: Generates `genius_output/Tmp/batch_<timestamp>.json` in the current workspace, runs genius.py by absolute path with `--batch` and `--concurrent 4`, reports all 4 file paths plus task_ids/media_urls, and deletes the batch config after completion.

evals.prompt: 查一下我现在还有多少积分
evals.expected_output: Runs genius.py by absolute path with `--balance` from the current workspace and reports the credit count.

evals.prompt: 测试一下这个 skill 能不能用
evals.expected_output: Runs the lightweight `scripts/test.py` by absolute path only because the user explicitly asked to test the skill, then reports pass/fail.

evals.prompt: 用 premium 模型生成一张 3K 高质量的咖啡机产品图
evals.expected_output: Runs genius.py by absolute path with `--model gpt-image-2-premium --resolution 3K --quality high` and workdir set to the current session workspace.

evals.prompt: 画一张 iPhone 17 Pro 的产品图
evals.expected_output: Runs with --model nano-banana-2 --google-search to ensure the model references real product images.
